capabilities: Insert or wrap callouts at the cursor from a searchable picker
Change or remove the callout type of the current block
Discover custom callouts from enabled CSS snippets
Search and navigate built-in and custom callouts by keyboard
Bind picker commands to hotkeys and toggle cursor-placement behavior
extras: Not yet listed in Obsidian Community Plugins; installs via GitHub release files. Desktop only, no network access, and requires Obsidian 1.13+ color format awareness for custom callout CSS.
motivation: The README says that if you use a lot of custom callouts, the plugin saves you from remembering callout ids or manually rewriting block syntax.
problem: Inserting callouts requires remembering callout ids and hand-writing block syntax, and custom callouts defined in CSS snippets have no picker to discover or switch them.
summary: Callout picker that inserts, wraps, retags, and removes callouts, including custom ones from CSS snippets, from the editor right-click menu.
